name: lint-before-finish
description: Deterministically enforces a common CLAUDE.md rule ('always run lint before finishing') instead of relying on the model remembering a written instruction. Fires on Stop: if the working tree has any uncommitted change, it runs `npm run lint` and blocks finishing (with the lint output as the reason) until it passes. Silent no-op on a clean tree. Requires a package.json `lint` script and `jq` on PATH — for a non-npm stack, copy this file into your project's own aistarterfiles/global/hooks/ (or local_dirs override) and swap the `npm run lint` invocation for your stack's equivalent (e.g. `make lint`, `poetry run ruff check .`).

hooks.command:
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then OUTPUT="$(npm run lint 2>&1)"; CODE=$?; if [ $CODE -ne 0 ]; then TRUNCATED="$(printf '%s' "$OUTPUT" | tail -c 4000)"; MSG="npm run lint failed. CLAUDE.md requires this to pass before finishing any code change. Fix the errors below, then finish again.

$TRUNCATED"; jq -n --arg reason "$MSG" '{decision:"block", reason:$reason}'; fi; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Running npm run lint (CLAUDE.md requires this before finishing)…
